name: tracker-dispatcher
goal: Port Tracker 122e190 launch intent, token claims, session adoption and run transitions through atomic injected persistence

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Pinned 122e190 dispatcher and run log. Verify explicit and due intent, reachable denial and sole-owner outage fallback, one claim per token, queued/running/verifying/finished transitions, adopted sessions, retry escalation and atomic receipt writes. Use artificial clocks and records only.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Implemented an injectable TrackerDispatcherService, token-bound ownership and due admission, an atomic runner reservation and receipt model, and pure reconciliation for startup, session adoption, verification, answers and retry.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: 19 test cases with disposable SQLite and one Vitest worker passed through the registered Harness scenario; captured eight output and assertion artifacts. Cases include launch idempotence, due grant and fresh admission, atomic rollback, session adoption, stale verification, answers, retries and receipts.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
